# Browser Bridge

> **v0.10.0 · 100% Local · Zero-Port Secure · Native-Rust FAST (~1.1 ms Pipe IPC) · Self-Evolving (14 Timestamped `routines/*.json` Playbooks, `SiteLearner`, Teach Recorder & WebMCP)** — MCP server, Native Messaging host, cross-browser extension (Edge, Chrome, Brave, Firefox), and zero-dependency Python SDK for your own signed-in browser tabs.

## One-Prompt AI Agent Installation & Upgrade

- [Agent Installation Playbook (docs/INSTALL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Step-by-step zero-build SHA-256-verified installer instructions for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex.
- [Upgrade Notes v0.7.0 -> v0.10.0 (docs/UPGRADE.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/UPGRADE.md): Timestamped `routines/*.json` (`schemaVersion: 2`) upgrade auto-merge, `[STALE]` drift detection, new Chromium `tabGroups` background grouping, and 5x–31x measured speedups.
- [Changelog & Benchmarks (CHANGELOG.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/CHANGELOG.md): Full release history and per-site speedup metrics across Google Search (12x), Google Docs (5.4x + 10 ms Canvas snapshot), Google Sheets/Excel (31x), GitHub (~50 ms README), ChatGPT, Amazon (6.4x), Yahoo Finance (11.5x), diagrams.net, YouTube, Wikipedia, Hacker News, Stack Overflow, Reddit, and X.
